purpose: Put real faces and credentials on the company: four founder cards (photo, name, role) that reveal a short bio on hover, introduced by a paragraph on where the team's experience comes from.

behaviour.note: Each card: landscape photo (aspect 635/422) with a dark name and role tag at the bottom-left in teal text. On hover (lg and up only) a full-card dark overlay fades in with the founder's bio.
Content gap: below lg the hover overlay does not exist as an interactive state (it is opacity 0 with no non-hover trigger), so the bio text is not reachable on touch or narrow screens.
Cards are laid out in a 2-column grid from sm (one column below). Section is on the plain background with a top pattern strip (pattern-10).
Photos are real people (the four founders); people, names, roles and bios must come from the real source content and never be generated or invented.

label.note: Eyebrow label with an icon. Observed 2 words.

lead.note: Bold opening sentence plus supporting text. Observed about 67 words (own count; the inventory's about 55 was not reproduced).

role.note: Observed 2 to 4 words, for example Co-Founder & CEO.

photo.note: Landscape crop (aspect 635/422) of the real person. Existing real file only; never generate, edit or substitute.

bio.note: Shown on hover from lg. Observed 54 to 66 words.

motion.reducedMotionNote: Proposal only: the code has no prefers-reduced-motion handling. Overlay opacity goes 0 to 1 on hover at lg and up, 200ms, default ease (cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) per tailwind.config.js:90). The closest closed-enum pattern is hover-color-transition; it is an opacity reveal rather than a colour change.

changes.change: bio overlay is not revealed (hover overlay is lg only); overlay padding is 24px then 32px from md
name tag offset from card edge grows (bottom 16, 24, 28, 33px; right 24, 32, 40, 48px)
